meta.name: story-deslop
meta.description: 网文去AI味。检测并清除文本中的AI写作痕迹，让文字回归自然、非模板化。触发方式：/story-deslop、/去AI味、「去AI味」「这篇太AI了」「网文去AI味」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 去除网文中的AI写作痕迹，让文字更自然
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你写网文但觉得文字太模板化、像AI写的
copy.tagline_en: Remove AI writing traces from web novels for more natural text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write web novels but find the text too templated or AI-like

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成网文润色专家，专门检测并清除文本中的 AI 写作痕迹，让文字更自然、口语化，减少模板化和书面腔。
howto.when: 当你输入网文文本并说“去AI味”、“这篇太AI了”或使用指令 /story-deslop 时触发。

say.text: 去AI味：这段对话太工整了，帮我改自然。
say.note: Claude 会检测并润色文本。

say.text: 这篇太AI了，帮我检查一下。
say.note: Claude 只检测不修改，输出问题报告。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a web novel polishing expert, specifically detecting and removing AI writing traces to make text more natural and colloquial, reducing templated and formal styles.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you input web novel text and say 'remove AI flavor', 'this is too AI', or use the command /story-deslop.

say_en.text: Remove AI flavor: this dialogue is too neat, make it more natural.
say_en.note: Claude will detect and polish the text.

say_en.text: This is too AI, please check it.
say_en.note: Claude only detects without modifying, outputs a problem report.
